name: agent-passport
description: Verifiable HCS-10 identity, communication channel and decision log for AI agents on Hedera.

steps.text: Agent Passport: HCS-10 identity and messaging for AI agents. No contracts to deploy; everything runs on Hedera Consensus Service.

steps.label: Create .env from the example and add a funded testnet account
steps.text: Copy .env.example to .env, then set HEDERA_OPERATOR_ID and HEDERA_OPERATOR_KEY.

steps.label: Register your agent, its peer and their HCS-10 connection
Publish a first decision from the command line
Open the passport UI at http://localhost:3000
